notes: as for is added because ואתם is a bare fronted pronoun with no object marker and no preposition on it (rule 16's limit on that family); headed on as.
no man is split — no to לא as the clause's negation recast onto the subject (rule 15), man to איש — since each morpheme keeps an English word and rule 35's single-word condition is unmet.
בפניכם fuses to the single before, headed on the construct noun (rule 30), while מפניכם earlier in the verse is split, each morpheme holding a word.
